liveFacilities.scope: OpenStation SIRI FM current facility-status observations
liveFacilities.rule: Retain and display the latest explicitly retrieved SIRI snapshot separately from historical analysis. Preserve source and retrieval timestamps; never use current status as evidence for the historical analysis date. Refresh only on explicit request, not on a background schedule.

dateBasis: Native observation timestamps, inclusive; timetable departures follow their separate August-only civil-date range. Reference snapshots use the latest available release regardless of reference year. Download, check and processing dates are provenance, not observations.

currentMapException.rule: Use the latest available maps, station directory and static infrastructure inventories, even after the analysis cutoff. Preserve actual publication/capture dates; these snapshots do not reconstruct past conditions. Facility-status observations are not covered by this exception.

timetable.dateBasis: Departure instants from 1 through 31 August 2026 in Europe/Berlin. Earlier GTFS service-day identifiers may be retained only as necessary calendar support for overnight departures inside August; they do not permit July departures or query windows.

latestReferenceSnapshots.rule: Use the latest available release of reference datasets. Preserve and display the actual reference, capture and publication dates, including dates before 2024 or after August 2026. A snapshot is not an observation time series and does not reconstruct historical conditions. Historical facility operating status and weather remain subject to the observation range; the separate liveFacilities rule governs explicitly requested current SIRI snapshots.

operationalArchive.dateBasis: Eligible native arrival/departure records within August only; reported changed times are not verified actual event times.
